validity.researcher_notes: Confirmed via at least 6 independent outlets (interfax.com, TASS, inform.kz/Kazinform, lada.kz, forbes.kz, vestikavkaza.ru) reporting a 2025-10-09 memorandum between Kazakhstan's government and Gazprom (signed at the St. Petersburg International Gas Forum) to build a new trunk gas pipeline named 'Ishim-Astana' / 'Ишим - Астана', running from a new Russian compressor station ('Karasulskaya', near the city of Ishim) across the border through Kazakhstan's North Kazakhstan and Akmola regions (Petropavlovsk, Kokshetau) to connect with Kazakhstan's EXISTING 'Saryarka' gas pipeline system near Astana. This is a genuinely distinct, real project -- not a duplicate of GEM's existing Saryarka Gas Pipeline entry (Saryarka is the pre-existing domestic KZ system this new pipeline will feed INTO, per lada.kz's Deputy Energy Minister quote), and not a hallucination or a stale/superseded proposal (Kazinform's Sept 2026 official Energy Ministry statement confirms the project is still actively moving forward with a firm end-2029 construction target). Status='proposed' matches the current stage: a signed memorandum with a preliminary schedule, no construction-start reported yet.
